font.reason: The card's only text is a single quiet technical caption on a dark neon-tech frame. Vazirmatn (variable, full weight range) is the neutral Persian product-UI sans and matches the muted monospace caption role of the original ('SF Mono',Menlo). Loaded via FaRoot so no silent fallback; verified rendered correctly (no fallback glyphs) in f40/f70/f100/f155 stills.

rtlDecisions.what: Morphing 140-point polar outline, per-point radius lerp, inOutCubic windows (0.08-0.42 / 0.58-0.92), breath scale, sin(t*2pi)*4deg self-rotation, hue 185->305, caption opacity 0.4+0.6*|m-0.5|*2
rtlDecisions.action: kept unchanged (numeric values, frames, easing, seeds identical)
rtlDecisions.why: Pure physical/rotational geometry with no reading-direction meaning: radially symmetric organic lobes, whole-number rotation cycle returning to 0 on the last frame, hue tied to form identity. Mirroring a rotationally symmetric morph would change nothing legible and would violate 'keep physical motion'. Verified by fa-vs-orig stills at f12/40/70/100/130/155: identical shape, glow, hue and beat at every frame.

rtlDecisions.action: translated to semantic Persian: «تبدیل به پیکرهٔ ب» / «تبدیل به پیکرهٔ الف»
rtlDecisions.why: The source prompt explicitly flags the original caption as a self-describing API placeholder that 'in the final video should become semantic text or be removed'. Persian letters الف/ب label the two shapes idiomatically; no Latin island remains so no bdi/unicodeBidi isolation is needed. textAnchor=middle is direction-neutral; the opacity cue (dimmest mid-morph) and switch threshold m>0.5 kept exactly.

rtlDecisions.what: letterSpacing:'2px' + monospace stack on the SVG text element
rtlDecisions.action: removed (letterSpacing 0 via faText); font set to Vazirmatn, size fs(10)=11px
rtlDecisions.why: letter-spacing breaks Persian letter joining (shared lesson #1). The Latin 'tracking' look has no Persian equivalent on a one-line label; hierarchy is carried by the muted colour/opacity as in the original. fs() x1.1 compensates smaller Persian x-height.

rtlDecisions.action: whole demo wrapped in FaRoot (direction:rtl + font)
rtlDecisions.why: Single centered text run; RTL root is the kit default and costs nothing while guaranteeing correct bidi base direction for the Persian caption.

rasterHandling: No raster/video assets in this card (pure SVG). Nothing to blur, replace or mirror.

text.timingNote: Caption swaps on the same m>0.5 threshold frame as the original; Persian strings have no animation of their own, so no beats shift. Persian caption is slightly wider than the Latin mono caption but stays well within the frame (verified f40/f70 stills).

verification: Viewed fa vs orig stills at frames 12, 40, 70, 100, 130, 155 (entrance, mid-morph A->B, B-hold, return breath, final resting A). Shape, glow, hue, breathing and caption state match frame-for-frame; Persian caption renders in real Vazirmatn with correct joining and the hamze on «پیکرهٔ». Full Persian MP4 rendered without errors (work/persian/out/svg-shape-morph/SvgShapeMorph.fa.mp4).
